Nina V.: Quick Q — Im heading to Argentina for 2 months. Can I keep Redwood health? Any tips for paying at private clinics?

Sam - People Ops: Yes as long as youre on payroll. Emergency = usually covered; routine = out-of-network. Keep itemized receipts and proof of payment.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: update temporary address in Workday if abroad >30 days. Submit foreign claims to benefits@redwood.com.

Nina V.: For prescriptions, can local pharmacies fill U.S. Rx?

Sam - People Ops: Sometimes. Best to get a paper international prescription from your doctor or take a 90-day supply. If you pay locally, collect: itemized invoice, proof of payment, simple English translation, and your Redwood ID. We’ll submit for reimbursement — expect 6-8 weeks.

Nina V.: Cool. Can I get the digital ID emailed to my personal account?

Sam - People Ops: Yes. Email preferences set to personal ok for that. I’ll send the PDF now. Also take photos of receipts at point of service.

Nina V.: Thanks! :airplane:
